info.name: Core accepted countries Payment Schedules API

params.name: account_token
params.description:
Unique identifier of the credit account for which you want to retrieve payment schedules.

Send a `GET` request to `/credit/accounts` to retrieve existing credit account tokens.

params.name: statuses
params.description: Status of the payment schedules to retrieve.

params.name: frequency
params.description: Frequency of the payment schedules to retrieve.

params.name: count
params.description: Number of payment schedule resources to retrieve.

params.name: start_index
params.description: Sort order index of the first resource in the returned array.

params.name: sort_by
params.description:
Field on which to sort.
Prefix the field name with a hyphen (`-`) to sort in descending order.
Omit the hyphen to sort in ascending order.

*NOTE:*
You must sort using system field names such as `lastModifiedTime`, and not by the field names appearing in response bodies such as `last_modified_time`.

items.docs:

items.docs: Create a new payment schedule, either one-time or recurring.

params.name: account_token
params.description:

params.name: payment_schedule_token
params.description:
Unique identifier of the payment schedule that you want to retrieve.

Send a `GET` request to `/credit/accounts/{account_token}/paymentschedules` to retrieve existing payment schedule tokens.
